svg.title: Booking a plot in the community garden
svg.desc:
Shaping · week 2 · three directions to compare A · Separate booking screen - place: Plot list - affordance: Plots free this season (copy) - affordance: Search plots (field) - affordance: Book a plot - affordance: Garden rules (link) - place: Booking - place: Plot form (in Booking) - affordance: Your name (field) (in Plot form) - affordance: Plot size (select) (in Plot form) - affordance: Check the map (in Plot form) - place: Map (in Booking) - affordance: Where the plot lies (scribble) (in Map) - affordance: Share with a neighbour (checkbox) - affordance: Confirm - affordance: Back to plots - place: Receipt - affordance: Plot 12 is yours until October (copy) - affordance: Done - place: Waiting list - affordance: Where you stand in the queue (scribble) - arrow: Book a plot → Booking - arrow: Garden rules → Waiting list - arrow: Check the map → Map - arrow: Confirm → Receipt - arrow: Confirm → Waiting list - arrow: Back to plots → Plot list - arrow: Done → Plot list
B · Side panel on the map - place: Garden map - affordance: Plot 12 (chevron) - affordance: Plot 14 (chevron) - place: Plot panel - affordance: Sunny, next to the shed (copy) - affordance: Soil and watering notes (scribble) - affordance: Water share (toggle) - affordance: Book - place: Receipt - affordance: Plot 12 is yours (copy) - affordance: Back to the plot - arrow: Plot 12 → Plot panel - arrow: Plot 14 → Plot panel - arrow: Book → Receipt - arrow: Back to the plot → Plot panel
C · Booking dialog - place: Plot list - affordance: Sunny plots (radio) - affordance: Shady plots (radio) - affordance: Plot 12 (handle) - affordance: Book - place: Booking dialog (in Plot list) - affordance: Your name (field) (in Booking dialog) - affordance: Confirm (in Booking dialog) - place: Receipt - affordance: See you at the garden (copy) - affordance: Change the booking - arrow: Book → Booking dialog - arrow: Confirm → Receipt - arrow: Change the booking → Booking dialog
